the middle element in a list as the pivot value and is sorting in 
ascending order, what will be the state of the partition shown on 
the right just before it is divided and the Quicksort method is 
called again? 
A) 11  6  0  5  7  10  9  8  3 
B) 0  3  5  6  7  8  9  10  11

3  8  10  5  7  0  9  6  11
questions.explanation:
For each partition of a Quicksort all elements that are less than the pivot value are 
moved to the left of the pivot and all elements greater than the pivot value are moved to 
the right of the pivot. In this example the first pivot value is 7. Working from the outside in, 
the first two values out of place, the 8 on the left and the 6 on the right, are switched.

switched. Once this happens, both partitions are now correct, with all values less than 7 
on the left, and all greater on the right.
